title: Favoured interpretation of quantum mechanics among 1,101 researchers, Nature survey, 2025
description: Bar chart of the percentage of the 1,101 usable respondents to Nature's 2025 survey of researchers in quantum physics who chose each interpretation as their favoured one. Copenhagen: 36 per cent. Information-based (the wave function represents only information): 17. Many worlds (with consistent histories, grouped in the survey): 15. Pilot wave (de Broglie–Bohm): 7. Spontaneous collapse: 4. Relational: 4. Everything else (other write-ins, none or unknown, shut up and calculate, superdeterminism, retrocausal, QBism): 18. Counted by kloom from Nature's published survey data.
heading: FAVOURED INTERPRETATION · % OF 1,101 · NATURE 2025
